subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this broad browser/search hardening task stay open as a scoped design umbrella, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower canonical issues before implementation?
rationale: Current main has partial browser/search capabilities, but choosing Lightpanda support, browser-backed extraction, benchmark criteria, and security boundaries changes product direction and trust boundaries beyond a narrow repair.

options.title: Split into approved tracks
options.body: Keep this open only long enough to define narrower issues for search-provider bugs, Lightpanda/external-CDP evaluation, browser-backed extraction, and benchmark/security criteria.

options.title: Close after moving details to canonicals
options.body: Move the browser-backed access and external-CDP portions to the existing open related issues and close this umbrella if maintainers do not want a separate matrix tracker.

options.title: Keep one umbrella implementation task
options.body: Use this as the single tracker for all browser/search hardening work, accepting that implementation will require manual coordination and security review.

recommendation.title: Split into approved tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this open only long enough to define narrower issues for search-provider bugs, Lightpanda/external-CDP evaluation, browser-backed extraction, and benchmark/security criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The current web tool split, browser plugin boundary, and security/product routing history most strongly point to steipete for deciding the shape of this work.
